TYPE <name> :
STRUCT

...
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

No semicolon after END_STRUCT. correct.

- When mode manual, selected pumps get RunComd = start AND selection AND NOT stop etc.
- Automatic: choose top 3 priority, set RunComd = start and not stop for chosen, others false.
- "stop button stops all pumps" so stop overrides run command.
- If no start? Could default? Start button likely momentary but hold? In PLC, buttons usually momentary. But no edge detection stated. Need latch until stop. Our latching runActive with stop priority and start sets true matches. They may expect latching; "start button, used to start" and "stop ... used to stop all pumps" means on activation state persists. Good.

Automatic selection: top 3 by priority. Tie breaking unspecified. We use rank with lower index tie better; reasonable. But potential issue: rank computation nested ranks duplicate allowed? For 5 unique yes. In tie, lower index gets higher rank. E.g priorities same, rank = 1 for i=1, rank =2 for i=2 etc. top <=3 is first three. Good.
